spec.title: Authors' own code: brain-wiring model predicts spread of Parkinson's-linked protein in mice, r = 0.696
spec.statement: Henderson et al. (Nature Neuroscience, 2019) modelled how alpha-synuclein, the protein linked to Parkinson's disease, spreads along the mouse brain's wiring. They report that the model's predictions match lab measurements with a correlation of 0.696 at 3 months. This re-runs the authors' own R code on their published data, with packages from the code's date. It's a settled showcase, not a forecast.

source.authors: M. X. Henderson, E. J. Cornblath, et al.

metric.name: correlation between predicted and measured pathology at 3 months
